sentences.en: Make it your law: logical thought, peaceful mind, virtuous action.
sentences.zh: 制定你的原则：逻辑思考，宁静心灵，道德行为。

sentences.en: She was hailed for her virtuous and selfless demeanor.
sentences.zh: 她因其高尚无私的行为而受到赞扬。

sentences.en: Any virtuous idea can be vicious in itself.
sentences.zh: 任何看似美好的想法也可能本身是邪恶的。

senses.zh: 善良的；有道德的；贞洁的
